memoryBuilder.verseText: Look! Your King is coming, gentle, riding on a donkey.

sequence.prompt: How did the King arrive? Put it in order.

items.label: God's people waited for the promised King
Jesus sent for a little donkey
People laid coats on the road

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: A king who comes to fight
A King who comes in peace
God kept a promise made long before

application.question: Our King is gentle. What is one way you could welcome Him into your day today?
application.followUp: Jesus could have taken a war horse and everybody would have cheered even louder. He chose the donkey because He was riding towards a cross, not a fight. Our King came gently.
